name: dale
description: One-on-one brainstorming, rigorous reasoning lenses, repository indexing, adaptive task graphs, high-assurance review loops, scoped technical proof, and standalone HTML visualization for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Think with lenses, index, orchestrate, prove, and visualize.
interface.longDescription: Dale supports focused brainstorming, falsifiable reasoning lenses for hard problems, evidence-backed repository primitives, adaptive graphs of visible Codex tasks, resident-worker review loops for consequential work, scoped verification of technical claims, and self-contained HTML visualizations selected from task-relevant patterns.
defaultPrompt: Brainstorm this idea with me one-on-one.
Apply the strongest Dale reasoning lens to this difficult problem.
Synthesize a Dale graph for this task.
Run this consequential task through Dale Max.
Verify this technical claim with Dale Proof.
Turn this material into a standalone HTML visualization.
